sponsors.pr_ja: ジーニーは、「誰もがマーケティングで成功できる世界を創る」、「日本発の世界的なテクノロジー企業となり、日本とアジアに貢献する」という2つのPurpose（企業の存在意義）のもと、企業の収益拡大・生産性向上など様々な課題解決につながるソリューションを開発・提供するマーケティングテクノロジーカンパニーです。
sponsors.pr_en: Based on the two goals of “creating a world where anyone can succeed in marketing” and “contributing to Japan and Asia by becoming a world-class technology company from Japan,” Genie is a marketing technology company that develops and provides solutions that help companies solve various problems, such as increasing revenue and improving productivity. We are a marketing technology company that develops and provides solutions that help companies solve a variety of problems, such as increasing profits and improving productivity.
